COLONOSCOPY REPORT

Patient: Morgan Ellery (fictional)
Synthetic record: SYN-GI-3005
Date of service: 2026-10-21
Place of service: 24 (ambulatory surgical center)
Endoscopist: Dr. Mei Tanaka, MD (fictional)

Procedure
Colonoscopy with cold snare polypectomy and cold forceps biopsy.

Indications
Screening colonoscopy, average risk; no prior colonoscopy.

Bowel preparation
Split-dose preparation. Boston Bowel Preparation Scale 8 (3-3-2); the bowel preparation was good.

Technique
The colonoscope was inserted into the rectum and advanced to the cecum, identified by the appendiceal orifice and ileocecal valve. Withdrawal time was 9 minutes.

Findings
Two sessile polyps, 4 mm and 6 mm, were found in the ascending colon; both were removed with a cold snare and retrieved.
A 3 mm area of nodular mucosa in the rectum was biopsied with cold forceps.
Small internal hemorrhoids. No other abnormalities.

Impression
Two ascending colon polyps removed by cold snare; rectal nodularity biopsied.

Recommendations
Await pathology. Repeat colonoscopy in 7 years, interval to be confirmed by pathology.
